design.controller: fixed global top-25 neurons selected on disjoint AdvBench rows 100-299
design.safety: same first 100 HarmBehavior examples at every strength
design.capability: same first 100 GSM8K test examples at every strength
design.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired bootstrap percentile 95% intervals for changes
design.hypothesis_tests: two-sided exact McNemar/binomial tests with Holm correction within each benchmark

safety_gain_vs_capability_loss_across_st.note: Descriptive dose-level association; strength conditions are not independent samples.
